articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Bugfixes

Fixed unresponsiveness issues across various connected devices.

Additional information
NOTE: Please note that this firmware release is not available for U7 Pro Max.


Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Release Candidate.
If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.


If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
Please post a support file as well
articles.title: UniFi Access Point 7.0.100

articles.author: UI-liusats
articles.description:
Improvements

Enhancements to increase reliability for 2.4 GHz wireless networks.

Bugfixes

Fixed IPv6 prefix assignment issue on RADIUS-assigned VLANs causing connectivity problems.
Fixed wireless uplink on the E7 model in scenarios where VLANs are configured for the SSID

Additional information
Please note that this firmware is not available for U7 Pro Max. We are actively working on adapting recent improvements for the U7 Pro Max and anticipate its release at a later date.

Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Official.
If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.


If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
Please post a support file as well
articles.title: UniFi Access Point 7.0.98

articles.author: UI-liusats
articles.description:
Improvements

Improved 2.4 GHz band connectivity and stability.
Improved 5 GHz auto-channel selection.
Improved Packet Capture feature.
Improved TX Retries reporting.
Improved connectivity at low signal levels.
Improved stability.

Bugfixes

Fixed various mobile device 6 GHz connectivity issues.
Fixed incorrectly reported disconnect events during client roam.
Fixed AP going offline when the Network application is unreachable for some time.

Additional information
Please note that this firmware is not available for U7 Pro Max. We are actively working on adapting recent improvements for the U7 Pro Max and anticipate its release at a later date.


To update your devices, set the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Official.


If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
Please post a support file as well
